$comment: Accept-list for dependency advisories that cannot be fixed within the currently pinned major versions. Every entry needs a GHSA id, the package name, the severity it was accepted at, a concrete reason, and an expiry date (UTC). Expired, stale, or severity-mismatched entries fail scripts/audit-deps.ts and force a re-review.

entries.reason: No fixed glob 13.x release exists and @vercel/nft 1.5.0 pins glob ^13.0.0. Build-time file tracing for the Vercel adapter only; never shipped to the runtime bundle.
Fix requires minimatch >=11.0.1 but all dependents (eslint, typescript-eslint, glob 13) pin ^10.x. Dev/build-time tooling only.

No fixed picomatch 4.x release exists yet (the latest published 4.0.7 is still inside the vulnerable range <=4.0.7) and both dependents (@rollup/pluginutils, @vercel/nft) pin ^4.0.2. Build-time tooling only - vite/rollup plugin matching and the Vercel adapter's file tracing - never shipped to the runtime bundle, and the ReDoS vector requires a hostile extglob pattern reaching picomatch at build time. Bump an override to the first fixed release when it lands.
All SvelteKit 2.x releases are in the vulnerable range; the fix is the 3.0.0 major upgrade, which is an owner decision, not a maintenance bump.

Patched only in 3.1.1; no fixed 2.x release exists (the vulnerable range spans every 2.x from 2.42.0 through 3.1.0). Affects only the experimental remote functions form-parsing path, and this app does not enable remote functions. The fix is the 3.0/3.1 major upgrade, which is an owner decision, not a maintenance bump.
